method: Unmodified generated RGBA sources; alpha>=192 connected-body spans with independent texture gutters; whole face registration, fixed source scale per hero/atlas, true sole baseline and measured empty-hand grip. No physics root or per-frame scale changes.

gun_contract: Body-only cels. A separate weapon texture rotates about grip_local; physics muzzle must derive from the same grip and actual weapon barrel_length. Aiming never swaps or rescales the whole body.
